title: Referral Request Intake Form
subtitle: Capture referral source, requested service, supporting record, and receiving provider; confirm appointment and result return.
description: Referral Request records referral source, requested service, supporting record, receiving provider, appointment, and result return. Referral Request evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this referral request structured intake when staff must document referral source and requested service. Reconcile supporting record, receiving provider, appointment, and result return before the referral request handoff. Use the request source, reason and requested specialty, records checklist, preferred-provider directory result, capacity response, appointment notice, and closed-loop report. Ask the assigned referral request reviewer to confirm referral source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Referral Request starting details
sections.guidance: Capture referral source, requested service and reason, urgency, supporting documents, preferred receiving provider, scheduling constraints, appointment, and result return. Keep any urgent referral request issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Referral Request reported needs review
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

blocks.label: Referral Request stated need or goal

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Referral Request intake readiness
items: Referral source is identified for this record
Requested service matches the current request or source
Supporting record is ready for point-of-use staff
Receiving provider limits or questions are resolved
Appointment is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: Referral Request receiving route
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Referral Request intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
